sources.title: Large language models as uncertainty-calibrated optimizers for experimental discovery
sources.method_relevant_to_this_study: GP marginal likelihood jointly optimizes representation and GP parameters. PLLM learns a projection of frozen LLM features; phi variants update LLM parameters. The main PLLM_phi method is broader than this study's frozen encoder plus projection.
sources.limits: Optimization benchmarks and calibrated-optimizer claims are not direct evidence of QGeoGNN active-learning AULC or calibrated column-chromatography response uncertainty.

sources.title: Official GOLLuM repository and PLLM configuration
sources.limits: Mutable main inspected as methodological reference, not installed or invoked; exact result reproduction is not claimed. This study uses learning-oriented offline batch acquisitions instead of EI.

sources.title: T5-base official checkpoint model card and file inventory
sources.cost_note: About 0.9 GB full fp32 checkpoint plus tokenizer and activation/runtime memory; only one framework's weights would be needed.

sources.title: Qwen1.5-0.5B-Chat official model card
sources.architecture: pretrained decoder-only Qwen2, post-trained chat checkpoint
sources.use_in_this_study: explicit exploratory local frozen decoder hidden-state masked-mean arm; never generate and never call remote inference
sources.limits: Not T5, not a trained semantic embedding encoder, not full GOLLuM reproduction. Model weights remain in their existing local cache.
